submitted.rationale: Across 5 EQE measurements (Sb 0.285, 0.398, 0.430, 0.558, 0.687), index 8 (Sb 0.43) had the highest EQE at 0.0056%. A quadratic fit through the bracketing points puts the maximum at about 0.436, right at index 8. The neighbour at 0.398 dropped sharply to 0.0025%, so the peak is narrow and sits between the Cu2SbO5 and CuSb2O6 compositions.
